title: AI 依赖倾向 AIDep-22
author: Houyu Wu, Haiyang Ni, Wenfu Luo & Tenglong Wu
notice: 本中文题目为依照正式论文英文题目所作的未验证翻译，未经过中文版心理测量验证。仅供娱乐和自我了解，不作诊断；不设临床分界值。仅供人类。原研究针对中国18–24岁大学生在学习任务中的AI使用，不代表所有人、所有AI使用场景或情感陪伴。此处是论文英文版题目的未验证中文回译，并非作者验证的中文原问卷。使用表2修订后的22题，删除初始题4/8/19/20。全量和各维度均分越高代表相应依赖表现越多；不将论文探索性分组包装成临床诊断。
instruction: 请根据自身通常的实际情况，选择你对每句话的认同程度。原文仅命名量尺两端，中间档位保留数字。

items.text: 没有AI的帮助，我会感到不安或缺乏安全感。
items.original: I feel uneasy or insecure without the help of AI.

items.text: 用AI辅助学习会让我感到平静和放松。
items.original: Using AI to assist my studies makes me feel calm and relaxed.

items.text: 如果不能用AI帮助学习，我会感到焦虑和沮丧。
items.original: I would feel anxious and frustrated if I couldn't use AI for my studies.

items.text: 每当遇到难题，我的第一反应就是希望AI能帮助我；否则，我会感到紧张。
items.original: Whenever I encounter a difficult problem, my first instinct is to hope AI can help me; otherwise, I feel tense.

items.text: 与AI互动（例如通过聊天提示）是一种愉快的体验，让我感到得到支持。
items.original: Interacting with AI (e.g., via chat prompts) is a pleasant experience that makes me feel supported.

items.text: 我几乎把所有学习任务都交给AI，因为它做得比我更快、更好。
items.original: I delegate almost all my academic tasks to AI because it performs them faster and better than I do.

items.text: 我依靠AI的功能（例如提供答案、写作建议）来提高学习效率。
items.original: I rely on AI's functions (e.g., providing answers, writing suggestions) to improve my learning efficiency.

items.text: 没有AI的辅助，我已经无法应付复杂的学习任务。
items.original: I can no longer manage complex academic tasks without the assistance of AI.

items.text: 比起完全自己完成，我更愿意把收集信息和组织内容交给AI。
items.original: I prefer to delegate information gathering and content organization to AI rather than doing it entirely myself.

items.text: 在学习中，我过度依赖AI提供的现成答案或解决方案。
items.original: In my studies, I excessively rely on the ready-made answers or solutions provided by AI.

items.text: 没有AI的支持，我会觉得自己在学习上力不从心。
items.original: I feel inadequate in my studies without the support of AI.

items.text: 我经常不先自己思考，就直接向AI索要答案。
items.original: I often ask AI for answers directly without thinking for myself first.

items.text: 使用AI之后，我独立分析和解决问题的能力下降了。
items.original: After using AI, my ability to independently analyze and solve problems has declined.

items.text: 面对学习上的挑战时，我依赖AI，而不是尝试自己想明白。
items.original: When faced with an academic challenge, I rely on AI instead of attempting to think it through on my own.

items.text: 长期使用AI之后，我变得不太愿意独立思考，更愿意让AI完成这些工作。
items.original: After long-term use of AI, I have become less inclined to think independently, preferring AI to do the work.

items.text: 我习惯让AI替我作判断和决定，而不是充分相信自己的判断。
items.original: I am accustomed to letting AI make judgments and decisions for me rather than fully trusting my own judgment.

items.text: 我试过减少使用AI，但从未能长期坚持。
items.original: I have tried to reduce my use of AI, but I have never succeeded for long.

items.text: 一旦开始使用AI，我常常很难停下来，即使已经花了很多时间。
items.original: Once I start using AI, I often find it difficult to stop, even after spending a lot of time on it.

items.text: 我知道不该太依赖AI，但我控制不住自己。
items.original: I know I shouldn't rely too much on AI, but I can't control myself.

items.text: 我几乎无法控制自己使用AI的频率和时长。
items.original: I have almost no control over the frequency and duration of my AI use.

items.text: 我有能力不用AI完成任务，但仍然忍不住使用它。
items.original: I am capable of completing tasks without AI, but I still cannot resist using it.

items.text: 如果一段时间不用AI，我会强烈地想用它，有时甚至感到烦躁。
items.original: If I don't use AI for a period of time, I feel a strong urge to use it, sometimes even feeling irritable.
